title: 10 Kenilworth Lane West, Rathgar, Dublin 6, D06H4C0
seoTitle: 10 Kenilworth Lane West, Rathgar, Dublin 6, D06H4C0
description:
- Large Beautifully Maintained Private South Facing Rear Garden

- Light, Bright & Spacious 2-Bedroom 2-Bathroom Home

- Off Street Secure Parking For Two Cars

- Excellent Specification Both Inside & Out

- Scope For Enlargement

- Outstanding Location Within Walking Distance Of Every Amenity

Premium Collection are delighted to bring to the market this wonderful red bricked 2 Bedroom semi-detached family home in the heart of Dublin 6. Built in 2000 this home has a light and bright open floor plan, with the main living spaces looking out over a sunfilled south facing private back garden. 

Wonderfully presented, the sense of light and space become immediately apparent upon entering the spacious hallway with a large living/dining room enjoying an abundance of sunlight through large double glazed windows and floor to ceiling glass patio doors. Across the hall there is a recently renovated contemporary kitchen offering plenty of shaker style cabinetry, ample counter-top space and a good selection of stainless steele integrated appliances.

Upstairs comprises two spacious bedrooms off a bright central landing with the master bedroom providing a bright shower room ensuite bathroom with floor to ceiling tile. There are quality fitted wardrobes in both bedrooms and the main bathroom is a good size and filled with natural light with a bath/shower combination and floor to ceiling tile.

Outside at the front there is off street and secure parking for two cars within a brick paved driveway and to the rear, the gardens are wonderfully maintained in a private south facing setting comprising a large stone paved patio, manicured lawn and an abundance of bedding including a good sized garden shed tucked away in the corner.

Offering plenty of scope for enlargement, this home is in a very special location with Kenilworth Lane being perfectly positioned within walking distance of Rathgar, Rathmines and Terenure, providing convenient access to a wide array of quality restaurants, cafes, and bars. In addition to the numerous recreational facilities nearby including the Leinster Sports Complex, Swan Leisure Centre, Stella Theatre, numerous Tennis, Bowling and Cricket Clubs,  swimming pools parks and playgrounds, there are an abundance of reputable primary and secondary schools and this location is highly convenient to the city centre whether it be by bus,bike or Luas.

Viewing Highly Recommended.
